name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (10e) Greenland should have a stronger voice in Arctic governance, enhance its security including through the development of critical infrastructure, and should gain access to Iris, Galileo and other relevant EU programmes. Should Greenland achieve EU candidate status, the Global Europe instrument could offer Greenland concrete pre-accession benefits through deeper strategic and economic cooperation with the Union.
